# PROJECT PATHS

```{r paths}
library(here)

# Local species-by-species Jaccard-distance matrices (5 m, 40 m, 400 m).
# These originate from the local community dataset, not the global grid.
local_coocurrence <- here("data", "processed", "local_analyses", "norway", "cooccurrence_matrices")

# Global niche-similarity matrices generated by 06_02_mantel_tests_and_residuals.Rmd.
global_matrix_dir <- here("results", "global_analyses", "mantel", "matrices")

save_path <- here("results", "local_analyses", "mantel")
save_path_figs <- file.path(save_path, "figures")
dir.create(save_path_figs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

required_files <- c(
  file.path(global_matrix_dir, "schoener_matrix.csv"),
  file.path(global_matrix_dir, "niche_jaccard_matrix.csv"),
  file.path(global_matrix_dir, "niche_distance_matrix.csv"),
  file.path(local_coocurrence, "jaccard_distance_5m.csv"),
  file.path(local_coocurrence, "jaccard_distance_40m.csv"),
  file.path(local_coocurrence, "jaccard_distance_400m.csv")
)
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
if (length(missing_files)) {
  stop("Missing input files:\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

```{r}
#head(jaccard_40m_mat)

#head(jaccard_400m_mat)

```

```{r}
# function to also use species names as rownames
clean_names <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    trimws() %>%
    gsub("\\.", " ", .) %>%
    gsub("_", " ", .) %>%
    gsub("\\s+", " ", .)
}

fix_square_matrix <- function(mat_or_df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(mat_or_df)
  sp_names <- clean_names(df$X)
  df <- df %>%
    select(-X)
  colnames(df) <- clean_names(colnames(df))
  rownames(df) <- sp_names
  mat <- as.matrix(df)
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  return(mat)
}

jaccard_5m_mat <- fix_square_matrix(jaccard_5m_mat)
jaccard_40m_mat <- fix_square_matrix(jaccard_40m_mat)
jaccard_400m_mat <- fix_square_matrix(jaccard_400m_mat)

niche_jaccard_matrix <- fix_square_matrix(niche_jaccard_matrix)
schoener_matrix <- fix_square_matrix(schoener_matrix)
niche_distance_matrix <- fix_square_matrix(niche_distance_matrix)
```

## Convert to distance

```{r}
# Convert schoener_matrix to distance
schoener_matrix_dist <- 1 - schoener_matrix

# Convert Jaccard similarity to distance
niche_jaccard_dist <- 1 - niche_jaccard_matrix

```



# COMMON SPECIES BETWEN GLOBAL MATRICES AND LOCAL SCALE 5 M

```{r}
local_mats <- list(
  "5m" = jaccard_5m_mat,
  "40m" = jaccard_40m_mat,
  "400m" = jaccard_400m_mat
)

global_mats <- list(
  "HV_Jaccard" = niche_jaccard_dist,
  "Schoener" = schoener_matrix_dist,
  "Centroid" = niche_distance_matrix
)
```

```{r}
library(vegan)

mantel_results <- list()

for(local_name in names(local_mats)){

  for(global_name in names(global_mats)){

    # matrices
    local_mat <- local_mats[[local_name]]
    global_mat <- global_mats[[global_name]]

    # common species
    common_sp <- intersect(
      rownames(local_mat),
      rownames(global_mat)
    )

    # filter
    local_filt <- local_mat[
      common_sp,
      common_sp
    ]

    global_filt <- global_mat[
      common_sp,
      common_sp
    ]

    # check order
    stopifnot(
      all(rownames(local_filt) == rownames(global_filt))
    )

    # mantel
    mantel_out <- mantel(
      as.dist(local_filt),
      as.dist(global_filt),
      method = "pearson",
      permutations = 9999
    )

    # save results
    mantel_results[[paste(local_name, global_name, sep = "_")]] <-

      data.frame(
        local_scale = local_name,
        niche_metric = global_name,
        n_species = length(common_sp),
        mantel_r = mantel_out$statistic,
        p_value = mantel_out$signif
      )
  }
}
```


```{r}
write.csv(mantel_results_df, file.path(save_path, "mantel_results_df.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
colors <- c(
  "HV_Jaccard" = "#80cdc1",
  "Schoener"   = "#a6cee3",
  "Centroid"   = "#ba8bc9ff"
)

line_plot <- ggplot(
    mantel_results_df,
    aes(
      x = local_scale,
      y = mantel_r,
      color = niche_metric,
      group = niche_metric
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Mantel correlation (r)",
    x = "Local scale"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

line_plot
```
